title: Microsoft Defender for Identity Sensor
description: Microsoft Defender for Identity sensor deployed on Domain Controllers to analyze directory-related traffic and authentication behavior for detection of identity-based attacks and suspicious activity.

implemented-requirements.description: The Microsoft Defender for Identity sensor monitors directory service traffic and authentication behavior to detect indicators of compromise and malicious activity.
Detected identity-based attack indicators are correlated and reported to centralized security operations platforms to support incident response.
Security-relevant events derived from directory traffic analysis contribute to audit review and anomaly detection activities.
